ValidationRule.description: Block the field PMC_SS_CustomerType__c for edition by users thar are not of Master Data or Admin profile
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_CustomerType__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Master Data or System Administrator team members can edit this field
